name: omanfo
description: The Omanfo plugin — Okyeame agent, Okyerema coordinator, and project management skills for the Anokye System.

items.usage:
recommended

The Okyeame (linguist) is the voice of the Anokye System — giving status updates, reporting on blocked issues, asking for clarity when needed, and facilitating project management via GitHub Issues.

optional

The Okyerema (master drummer) sets the rhythm — configuring agentic workflows, CI/CD pipelines, patrol schedules, and automation scaffolding.

recommended

The Okyerema (talking drummer) skill teaches agents how to create issues with organization types, build parent-child hierarchies, manipulate GitHub Projects via GraphQL, and verify relationships.

optional

Document co-authoring skill for collaborative document creation.

optional

Skill for generating and manipulating DOCX files.

optional

Skill for creating GitHub issues with proper structure.

optional

Skill for generating and manipulating PDF files.

optional

Skill for generating and manipulating PPTX presentations.

optional

Skill for product management workflows.

optional

Skill for creating new skills.

optional

Skill for generating and manipulating XLSX spreadsheets.
